using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using Moq.Protected;
using OpenRA;
using OpenRA.FileSystem;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Game.Tests.Map
{
	public class MapPreviewTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_DoesNotCallHttpClient_WhenStatusIsNotDownloadErrorOrDownloadAvailable()
		{
			var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
			var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>(MockBehavior.Strict);
			var preview = new MapPreview("test-uid", mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, null, null);

			// Set status to something other than DownloadError or DownloadAvailable
			preview.innerData.Status = MapStatus.Available;

			var mockInstallLocation = new Mock<FileSystem>();
			mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(new Dictionary<string, MapClassification> { { "test-path", MapClassification.User } });
			mockInstallLocation.Setup(l => l.Key).Returns(new Mock<IReadWritePackage>().Object);

			await preview.Install("http://test.com/");

			// Verify no HTTP call was made (indirectly verified by no exceptions and status unchanged)
			Assert.Equal(MapStatus.Available, preview.Status);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_DoesNotCallHttpClient_WhenDownloadingIsDisabled()
		{
			var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
			var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>(MockBehavior.Strict);
			mockModData.Setup(m => m.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading).Returns(false);
			var preview = new MapPreview("test-uid", mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, null, null);

			preview.innerData.Status = MapStatus.DownloadAvailable;

			await preview.Install("http://test.com/");

			Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadAvailable, preview.Status);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_CallsHttpClientGetAsync_WithCorrectUrl()
		{
			var httpTestHandler = new HttpMessageHandlerMock();
			var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>(httpTestHandler.Object);
			var mockHttpClientFactory = new Mock<HttpClientFactory>();
			mockHttpClientFactory.Setup(f => f.Create()).Returns(mockHttpClient.Object);

			// Replace HttpClientFactory static in test scope (integration test style)
			var originalFactory = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockHttpClient.Object;

			try
			{
				var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
				var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
				mockModData.Setup(m => m.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading).Returns(true);
				var preview = new MapPreview("test-uid", mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, null, null);

				mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(new Dictionary<string, MapClassification> { { "test-path", MapClassification.User } });
				var mockPackage = new Mock<IReadWritePackage>();
				mockPackage.Setup(p => p.Key).Returns(mockPackage.Object);

				preview.innerData.Status = MapStatus.DownloadAvailable;

				var mapUrl = "http://test.com/test-uid";
				await preview.Install("http://test.com/");

				mockHttpClient.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(mapUrl, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, default(CancellationToken)), Times.Once);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalFactory;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_SetsDownloadError_OnHttpFailure()
		{
			var httpTestHandler = new HttpMessageHandlerMock();
			httpTestHandler.SimulateResponse(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
			var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>(httpTestHandler.Object);

			var originalFactory = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockHttpClient.Object;

			try
			{
				var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
				var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
				mockModData.Setup(m => m.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading).Returns(true);
				var preview = new MapPreview("test-uid", mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, null, null);

				mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(new Dictionary<string, MapClassification> { { "test-path", MapClassification.User } });
				var mockPackage = new Mock<IReadWritePackage>();
				mockPackage.Setup(p => p.Key).Returns(mockPackage.Object);
				preview.innerData.Status = MapStatus.DownloadAvailable;

				await preview.Install("http://test.com/");

				Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, preview.Status);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalFactory;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_SetsDownloadError_WhenNoContentDispositionFilename()
		{
			var httpTestHandler = new HttpMessageHandlerMock();
			httpTestHandler.SimulateSuccessNoFilename();
			var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>(httpTestHandler.Object);

			var originalFactory = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockHttpClient.Object;

			try
			{
				var mockCache = new Mock<MapCache>();
				var mockModData = new Mock<ModData>();
				mockModData.Setup(m => m.Settings.Game.AllowDownloading).Returns(true);
				var preview = new MapPreview("test-uid", mockModData.Object, mockCache.Object, null, null);

				mockCache.Setup(c => c.MapLocations).Returns(new Dictionary<string, MapClassification> { { "test-path", MapClassification.User } });
				var mockPackage = new Mock<IReadWritePackage>();
				mockPackage.Setup(p => p.Key).Returns(mockPackage.Object);
				preview.innerData.Status = MapStatus.DownloadAvailable;

				await preview.Install("http://test.com/");

				Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, preview.Status);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalFactory;
			}
		}
	}

	// Helper for mocking HttpClient
	public class HttpMessageHandlerMock : DelegatingHandler
	{
		private HttpResponseMessage response;

		public void SimulateResponse(HttpStatusCode statusCode, string filename = "test.map")
		{
			response = new HttpResponseMessage(statusCode);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filename))
			{
				response.Content = new Mock<HttpContent>().Object;
				response.Content.Headers.ContentDisposition = new System.Net.Http.Headers.ContentDispositionHeaderValue("attachment") { FileName = filename };
			}
		}

		public void SimulateSuccessNoFilename()
		{
			response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK);
			response.Content = new Mock<HttpContent>().Object;
		}

		protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Task.FromResult(response);
		}
	}
}
